pages.text: Alcohol varies with serving volume, brew family and stage. It softens most incoming damage by up to 20% and slows saturation loss from exhaustion by up to 50% at full strength.

pages.title: Side Effects
pages.text: Alcohol can cause camera drift, double vision and slurred chat. Very high intensity risks poisoning, which still deals damage. A hangover can follow sleep. Stop taking servings and give the effect time to fall.

pages.title: Kava
pages.text: Kava uses the same type of effect, including the visuals, chat changes and exhaustion behavior. It is a registered beverage with pack-dependent availability.
